data.sources_note: 逐則列明原始來源及實際日期；公司功能與推出安排按公告歸因，未把供應商聲稱當作獨立成效。
data.sources_note_en: Original sources and actual dates accompany each story. Product and rollout claims are attributed to their issuers, not presented as independently tested results.

items.title: OpenAI發布Images 2.6，加入GIF及API標註編輯
items.title_en: OpenAI releases Images 2.6 with GIF creation and API markup editing
items.summary: 11月4日公告把圖像更新帶到ChatGPT、Codex及API，開發者可選Flare或Sunburst。
items.summary_en: The November 4 announcement brings the image update to ChatGPT, Codex and the API, with Flare and Sunburst for developers.
highlights: 新增循環GIF創作，可用於角色動畫及社交素材。
API支援局部標註修改、SVG輸出及complexity參數。
highlights_en: GIF creation supports animated characters and social assets.
The API adds markup-guided edits, SVG output and a complexity control.
items.why: 創意團隊可把靜態概念延伸至短循環素材，並在同一工作流程內安排修改。
items.why_en: Creative teams can extend still concepts into short loops and organize revisions within one workflow.
items.next_step: 以一張已獲授權的品牌素材測試局部修改，逐項核對字樣、商品細節及輸出格式。
items.next_step_en: Test a targeted edit on an authorized brand asset, checking text, product details and output format.
items.detail: OpenAI稱，新版本可在多輪修改中更好保留角色、產品與品牌細節。這屬供應商對能力的描述，並不保證每次輸出完全一致。Flare與Sunburst是API的兩個選項；圖像品質與complexity分別控制視覺細節及場景規劃，不能混為同一設定。SVG輸出亦不代表檔案已符合印刷規格。帳戶及地區權限、字體與商標細節仍應在正式製作前核對。
items.detail_en: OpenAI describes improved detail retention across edits; this is a vendor claim, not a fidelity guarantee. API quality and complexity are distinct controls. SVG output still requires production checks, including fonts, logos and print specifications. Confirm account and regional access.

items.title: Clarity串連代理流量與商品發現，Ask Clarity仍限封閉測試
items.title_en: Clarity connects agent traffic and product discovery; Ask Clarity remains in closed beta
items.summary: Microsoft於11月4日更新Clarity，讓網站團隊觀察代理行為，並擴展合資格商戶的Brand Agents。
items.summary_en: Microsoft’s November 4 Clarity update adds agent behavior tools and expands Brand Agents for eligible merchants.
highlights: 任務模擬先聚焦商務與旅遊場景。
Ask Clarity按會話證據回答問題，目前僅向零售商封閉測試。
highlights_en: Task simulations initially focus on commerce and travel.
Ask Clarity answers from session evidence and is in closed beta for retailers.
items.why: 旅遊及零售網站可分開檢查真人瀏覽與代理執行，找出預約或結帳流程的障礙。
items.why_en: Travel and retail sites can inspect human browsing and agent execution separately to locate booking or checkout friction.
items.next_step: 先查帳戶功能及商戶資格，再選一項搜尋至預約流程作模擬；把失敗步驟交網站團隊處理。
items.next_step_en: Check feature access and merchant eligibility, then simulate one search-to-booking task and assign failures to the web team.
items.detail: Brand Agents的商品發現擴展適用於合資格WooCommerce及Shopify商戶，產品可在Copilot、Bing及MSN等體驗出現，購買仍於商戶網站完成。本地服務預約則涉及合資格WordPress企業及支援的CRM或排程系統。這些功能的開放條件不同，不能因公告提到全球用戶，就認定全部帳戶已有Ask Clarity。模擬任務完成亦不等於真實消費者已成交。
items.detail_en: Product discovery covers eligible WooCommerce and Shopify merchants; shoppers complete purchases on the merchant site. Local booking involves eligible WordPress businesses and supported systems. These access conditions differ from Ask Clarity’s closed beta. A completed simulation is not a recorded sale.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: SeenThis早期開放Studio MCP，把AI簡報接入可編輯影片廣告
items.title_en: SeenThis opens early access to Studio MCP for editable video ads from AI briefs
items.summary: 11月5日公告讓支援MCP的AI工具連接SeenThis Studio，素材經批准後再分發。
items.summary_en: The November 5 release connects MCP-compatible AI tools to SeenThis Studio, with approval before distribution.
highlights: 可製作不同格式、語言及優惠版本，並提供客戶預覽。
只限部分代理商及品牌，使用者須登入Studio帳戶。
highlights_en: Teams can create format, language and offer variants with client previews.
Access is limited to selected agencies and brands using their Studio accounts.
items.why: 代理商可把品牌要求與廣告製作規格放進同一流程，減少交接時遺漏版本要求的機會。
items.why_en: Agencies can connect brand requirements and ad production specifications in one workflow, reducing version handoff gaps.
items.next_step: 申請前先列出所需格式、追蹤及客戶批准流程，確認現有AI工具與Studio權限。
items.next_step_en: List formats, tracking needs and approval steps before requesting access, and check AI-tool and Studio permissions.
items.detail: MCP是讓AI工具連接外部軟件的協議。按SeenThis公告，AI工具帶入品牌資料，Studio提供製作模板與技術指引；團隊可審閱預覽，再把已批准的廣告從Studio送往DV360、Meta或TikTok。這並非所有用戶已可使用的無人投放服務。公告中的製作時間縮短比例屬公司早期測試，本報未作獨立驗證，因此不沿用為預期成效。
items.detail_en: MCP connects AI tools to external software. SeenThis describes brand context meeting Studio templates and technical guidance, with previews and approved delivery to DV360, Meta or TikTok. Limited early access is not unattended universal launch. Vendor production-time savings are omitted.

items.title: KPMG與GS1香港報告：信任AI與願意分享資料仍有落差
items.title_en: KPMG and GS1 Hong Kong report a gap between AI trust and data-sharing comfort
items.summary: 11月4日發布的研究指出，香港與大灣區其他城市在AI信任及銀髮消費取向上呈現差異。
items.summary_en: The November 4 release describes differences in AI trust and older consumers’ shopping priorities between Hong Kong and other GBA cities.
highlights: 研究把透明度、準確性與人工支援列為建立信任的要點。
銀髮市場的價格、品牌及體驗取向需按地區分開理解。
highlights_en: The report emphasizes transparency, accuracy and human support.
Price, brand and experience priorities among older shoppers differ by market.
items.why: 零售品牌設計AI個人化服務時，應分開處理服務價值與資料授權，避免將信任視作同意。
items.why_en: Retailers should separate the value of AI personalization from data consent rather than treating trust as permission.
items.next_step: 檢查AI客服及會員流程是否清楚解釋資料用途、提供人工轉接，並按市場分開測試訊息。
items.next_step_en: Check data-use explanations and human handoff in AI service and membership flows, testing messages by market.
items.detail: 這篇採用研究機構經新聞稿公布的結論，並非本報獨立重做消費者調查。原始問卷、完整樣本及調查執行方法未經本輪查閱，因此不引用比例，也不把結果推算至全部香港或大灣區居民。報告把香港較重視價格與其他城市較重視品牌、體驗的差異列為策略方向；實際品牌仍宜以自身顧客資料驗證。信任AI、願意分享資料與真正購買，是不同的判斷。
items.detail_en: These are attributed research conclusions, not an independently repeated survey. The full questionnaire, sample and fieldwork methods were not inspected, so percentages and population extrapolations are omitted. Brands should validate the reported market differences with their own customers. Trust, consent and purchase are distinct.

items.title: JAPAN AI以兩支B2B廣告訴求落地支援，「三個月成果」另設明確定義
items.title_en: JAPAN AI promotes implementation support in two B2B ads, qualifying its three-month message
items.summary: 11月4日日文公告安排11月起投放網上及交通廣告，強調平台配合專家支援。
items.summary_en: The November 4 Japanese release schedules web and transit advertising from November, combining a platform with expert support.
highlights: 兩支30秒廣告分別呈現落地支援及員工知識轉成AI代理。
原文註明三個月指營運與量度啟動，須符合條件，並非收入保證。
highlights_en: Two 30-second ads present implementation support and agents built from employee expertise.
The footnote defines conditional three-month results as starting operations and measurement, not guaranteed revenue.
items.why: B2B AI品牌可參考它如何把軟件功能轉成服務承諾，同時清楚界定承諾的交付範圍。
items.why_en: B2B AI brands can examine how software features become a service promise with a clearly defined delivery scope.
items.next_step: 檢查自身廣告中的時間與成果字眼，讓主標、註腳、銷售簡報及合約採用同一定義。
items.next_step_en: Align time-and-outcome claims across headlines, footnotes, sales decks and contracts.
items.detail: 這篇是品牌溝通案例，沒有已核實的獲客增長結果。日文原稿清楚解釋，「成果」是開始營運及效果量度，三個月視乎條件與項目而異，不保證三個月內增加銷售或利潤。若只看英文行業報道的宣傳摘要，容易把這句理解成業績承諾。本報採用11月4日原始公告日期，並保留11月分階段投放安排，未聲稱曾觀看或實測相關服務。
items.detail_en: This is a communications case, not verified acquisition performance. The Japanese footnote limits the three-month promise to operational and measurement launch, conditional on the project, and excludes guaranteed sales or profit. The original release date is November 4, with phased November distribution.

items.title: Attain把購物受眾原生接入Amazon Ads DVA+，由量度延伸至投放
items.title_en: Attain adds native purchase audiences to Amazon Ads DVA+, extending beyond measurement
items.summary: 11月4日公告讓廣告主直接使用Attain購物受眾，新增按零售商及購物渠道劃分的選項。
items.summary_en: The November 4 release enables native use of Attain purchase audiences with retailer and shopping-channel segments.
highlights: 可按零售商組合、商品類別及線上或店內購買分組。
公司稱經授權的購物訊號每日更新；資料背景為美國市場。
highlights_en: Segments cover retailer combinations, purchase categories and online or in-store shopping.
Attain says permissioned purchase signals refresh daily; the data context is the US.
items.why: 面向美國市場的旅遊、餐飲及零售廣告主，可評估實際購物訊號能否補充既有受眾設定。
items.why_en: Travel, restaurant and retail advertisers targeting the US can assess purchase signals alongside existing audience definitions.
items.next_step: 先確認可購受眾的地區、門檻及資料用途，再以對照組檢查增量，避免只看平台歸因。
items.next_step_en: Confirm geography, minimums and permitted uses, then evaluate incrementality against a control rather than attribution alone.
items.detail: Attain與Amazon在2025年的合作已涉及線下銷售增量量度，今次公告的變化是把購物訊號帶到投放前的受眾建立及啟用。這不是新增一份已證實的成效研究。公司亦提到未在Amazon銷售的品牌可使用相關訊號；這描述應用對象，並不保證每個帳戶或市場都有相同資料。香港團隊若服務美國客戶，可先查清資料地區與使用條款，不能直接套用至香港消費者。
items.detail_en: The 2025 relationship involved offline sales-lift measurement; the new step is audience activation earlier in campaigns. This is not evidence of improved results. Non-Amazon sellers are an intended use case, not proof of identical coverage for every market or account. Check US targeting and permitted data uses.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Conductor公布AEO產品組合，以推薦份額連接內容優化工作
items.title_en: Conductor announces an AEO suite linking recommendation share to content work
items.summary: 11月3日公告把AI推薦量度、優先工作及內容寫作工具放進同一產品方向。
items.summary_en: The November 3 announcement links AI recommendation measurement, prioritized actions and content tools.
highlights: Recommendation Share旨在區分品牌被提及與被積極推薦。
Actions整理內容、技術基礎及第三方引用的改善機會。
highlights_en: Recommendation Share distinguishes mentions from stronger recommendations.
Actions organizes content, technical and third-party citation opportunities.
items.why: 品牌比較AI搜尋工具時，可檢查指標能否對應實際內容工作，並避免把曝光分數直接當作收入。
items.why_en: Brands can assess whether AI search metrics map to practical content work without treating visibility scores as revenue.
items.next_step: 要求供應商展示一個真實問題的原始答案、評分方法及修改後追蹤，確認帳戶開放安排。
items.next_step_en: Request raw answers, scoring logic and change tracking for one real query, and confirm account availability.
items.detail: AEO即答案引擎優化，關注品牌在AI答案中的呈現。Conductor的Recommendation Share屬其自行定義的指標；Custom Market Index則用於界定追蹤市場及問題，Actions把洞察轉成待處理工作。這份公告沒有提供足以獨立判定收入增量的證據，也未逐項列明所有帳戶的開放時間。本報採用11月3日公告日期，不把近日轉載當作新一次推出。
items.detail_en: AEO concerns representation in AI answers. Recommendation Share is Conductor’s own metric; Custom Market Index defines the market and questions, while Actions organizes work. The release does not establish incremental revenue or universal account availability. Its date remains November 3.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Prompted Brand在美國推出，把AI可見度工作與廣告審批放進同一平台
items.title_en: Prompted Brand announces US launch, combining AI visibility work and ad approvals
items.summary: 11月5日公告主打由AI答案產生待辦工作，ChatGPT廣告則經品牌自己的廣告帳戶處理。
items.summary_en: The November 5 release turns AI answers into work items and routes ChatGPT ads through a brand’s own advertiser account.
highlights: 待辦涵蓋內容缺口、引用網站、錯誤資料及爬蟲阻擋。
工作流程設人工批准；廣告另有每月上限及自動暫停。
highlights_en: Tasks cover content gaps, citation sites, wrong facts and crawler blocks.
Workflows pause for approval; ads have monthly caps and automatic pausing.
items.why: 品牌可把AI搜尋報告連到負責人及審批，並分開追蹤自然可見度與付費活動。
items.why_en: Brands can connect AI search reporting to owners and approvals while tracking organic visibility separately from paid activity.
items.next_step: 先查支援市場、語言及方案，再要求展示原始答案至待辦、審批及修訂紀錄的完整流程。
items.next_step_en: Check markets, languages and plans, then request a demonstration from raw answers to work items, approval and change history.
items.detail: 這是11月5日的美國推出公告；公司官方資料頁在10月29日已列出相關能力，因此不能把所有功能寫成當日首次出現。FactCheck按品牌提供的已核實資料檢查AI說法，資料本身仍需品牌維護。官方方案亦顯示各層級支援的引擎與功能不同。付費廣告不等於保證取得自然引用，本報亦未獨立驗證其可見度改善效果或香港帳戶適用性。
items.detail_en: This is a US launch announcement, not proof that every feature first appeared on November 5: the official facts page was updated October 29. Brand-supplied verified facts require upkeep, and features vary by plan. Paid placement does not guarantee organic citations or Hong Kong availability.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Pangram發布Image 1.0，加入局部熱圖及影片逐格偵測
items.title_en: Pangram releases Image 1.0 with heatmaps and frame-level video detection
items.summary: 11月4日更新涵蓋圖像、影片及API，較低解像度輸入會附信心提示。
items.summary_en: The November 4 update covers images, video and API access, with confidence caveats for lower-resolution inputs.
highlights: 圖像最低尺寸降至256×256；低於512的結果附提示。
Image Flash 1.0可逐格分析上載影片。
highlights_en: Minimum image input falls to 256×256, with a caveat below 512.
Image Flash 1.0 can analyze uploaded video frame by frame.
items.why: 品牌審閱外來素材時，可多一項篩查線索，配合原檔、授權及供應商製作紀錄核對。
items.why_en: Brands gain another screening signal for incoming assets, alongside originals, licenses and production records.
items.next_step: 先以已知來源的真實及合成素材測試誤判；有爭議時由人手查原檔，不單靠分數拒稿。
items.next_step_en: Test false positives on known real and synthetic assets; inspect originals manually before rejecting disputed material.
items.detail: Pangram稱新模型可標示圖像中疑似AI區域，並透過瀏覽器擴充及API提供相關功能。公司同時公布自有及學術測試結果；本報沒有重做測試，因此不沿用其準確率作獨立結論。壓縮、修改及低解像度會影響審閱情境，偵測標記應視為進一步查證的起點。它不能單獨證明素材作者、授權是否有效，亦不能作為侵權或欺詐判定。
items.detail_en: Pangram describes localization of suspected AI regions and browser/API access. Its benchmark accuracy is not independently reproduced here. Detection should trigger further checking, especially on compressed or edited assets; it cannot establish authorship, license validity, infringement or fraud.

items.title: MMA公布新加坡TMI 2026，11月24至25日聚焦AI行銷實作
items.title_en: MMA announces Singapore’s TMI 2026 for hands-on AI marketing on November 24–25
items.summary: 11月5日公告安排在Gardens by the Bay舉行兩日活動，面向APAC行銷及增長管理層。
items.summary_en: The November 5 announcement schedules a two-day Gardens by the Bay event for APAC marketing and growth leaders.
highlights: 體驗區規劃涵蓋洞察與資料、跨渠道創意、商務與量度。
主辦方安排實作及案例環節；活動尚未舉行。
highlights_en: Planned zones cover insights/data, omnichannel creative, and commerce/measurement.
The organizer plans hands-on work and cases; the event has not yet taken place.
items.why: 規劃團隊培訓時，可按現有AI導入問題篩選議程，讓學習對應具體工作與決策。
items.why_en: Teams planning training can select sessions around actual AI adoption problems and related decisions.
items.next_step: 先看最新議程、票務及所需工具，列出一項希望帶回團隊驗證的流程；毋須因活動公告立即採購。
items.next_step_en: Review the current agenda, ticket terms and tool requirements, and identify one workflow to validate afterward.
items.detail: MMA把活動定位為由概念走向實作的行銷交流，公告提到工作坊、體驗區及組織治理框架。這些屬主辦方的內容規劃，不能當作已發生的學習成果或商業成效。11月5日是公告日期，正式活動預定11月24至25日，兩者不可混淆。參與團隊宜自行核對最新場次、費用、資料分享及工具帳戶要求，本報未替任何人登記或購票。
items.detail_en: Workshops, zones and governance frameworks are organizer plans, not demonstrated learning or business outcomes. November 5 is the announcement date; the event is scheduled for November 24–25. Check current sessions, fees, data-sharing conditions and account needs before attending.

evidence.audit_status: Original source text and issuer releases read; separate-request same-assistant re-examination completed and recorded per story. Some direct opens failed; full indexed original/syndicated issuer text was read instead, with limitations. Survey percentages, vendor ROI and accuracy claims omitted. No separate reviewer, human approval, product trial or independent performance verification claimed.

review_provenance.first_pass: Original company text, official product documentation and dated direct reporting inspected, not headlines alone.
review_provenance.second_pass: Same assistant separately re-retrieved source text to challenge dates, release stages, scope, attribution and unsupported outcomes; individual references retained.

source_documents.evidence_locator: Original announcement introduction and Animate your ideas with GIFs, lines 35, 40–42.; Faster iteration, lines 38–39; availability, line 74.; More ways to create and edit in the API, lines 58–65.
source_documents.access_method: Original full source text opened and separately retrieved again for second-pass challenge.
source_documents.limitations: Reopened API and availability sections. Retained distinct Flare/Sunburst and API controls; omitted vendor speed and usage statistics. Availability attributed to OpenAI and subject to normal regional/account access; no product trial or guaranteed brand fidelity.

source_documents.evidence_locator: November 2026 > Nov 4, lines 976–987: Sunburst, Flare, complexity, SVG, GIF and markup edits.
